messages:
jordan: Hey team — planning to move my home base from OR to WA next month because my partner accepted a job. What's the process for updating homebase and handling WFH stipend vs relocation? Any tax nexus flags?

maya (people-ops): Congrats! :tada: Short answer: update homebase in the People Portal and we'll coordinate payroll/benefits. A few things to check — see checklist below.

maya (people-ops): Checklist (high-level):
- Submit Homebase change in People Portal -> HR > Personal Info.
- Attach move date and whether it's permanent (>=6 months) or temporary.
- People Ops will open a payroll change ticket to update state withholding and benefits region.
- Confirm whether you need equipment shipments or relocation shipping (this affects customs and invoicing).
- WFH stipend: prorated to your last day in the previous state. Relocation allowance: only for company-approved relocations (business need or permanent hire relocation).
- If you keep benefits in the old region for a short overlap, tell us so we can avoid coverage gaps.

avi? (avi (tax-ops)): Quick tax note: WA has no state income tax, but we still need to update payroll for unemployment insurance (UI) and any local taxes. Moving across states can also affect withholding forms — upload any new state/local withholding docs within 14 days of move.

jordan: Thanks — do I qualify for relocation? It's personal (moving in with partner), not company-driven. No furniture shipping.

maya (people-ops): Personal moves generally don't meet relocation allowance criteria. If it's personal and <6 months, relocation reimbursement is unlikely. You should get prorated WFH stipend for the month you change homebase. If you do incur any one-off costs (like shipping small work equipment) submit expense with notes and we'll review.

jordan: Understood. Anything else I need to sign or forms to fill out?

maya (people-ops): Please complete the Homebase Change form in the portal and update your personal address and emergency contact. If your bank changes, update payroll banking too. Link: https://intranet.redwood/people-ops/homebase-change (internal). After you submit, reply here so I can confirm and raise the payroll ticket.

avi? (avi (tax-ops)): Also flag: if you keep any contract or vendor work tied to OR, let us know — having business activity in a state can create nexus beyond payroll. We'll scope it.

jordan: Done — I submitted the portal request just now.

people-ops-bot: Ticket #HR-4821 created and assigned to maya (people-ops). Estimated turnaround: 3 business days.

maya (people-ops): Got it — I'll DM you if payroll needs additional docs. Welcome to WA in advance! :slightly_smiling_face:
